provenance.twoD: Original RDKit coordinate graphs; drawn as live SVG, no source-image pixels
provenance.threeD: ETKDGv3 fixed seeds per nonmetal fragment; computed illustrative conformers without force-field energy optimization. E2 reactants are reoriented to tracked anti H-C-C-Br180degrees; internal branch chooses an E-compatible chain conformation. Permanganate assigned tetrahedral1.63Angstrom coordinates. Not experimental coordinates, transition states or a reaction trajectory. Separated fragments arranged for viewing. Mapped H explicit; other H attached to parent. ZnO is a grouped formal net oxygen-sink icon, not a prediction of oxide precipitation/final zinc speciation; MnO2 is a grouped solid formula-unit icon. Their spacing is assigned bookkeeping, not molecular/lattice geometry or free aqueous ions. Metal spin/magnetism not modeled; radical count includes only nonmetal Lewis radicals.
